head: Lift Fried Food
and Drain Oil Fast
hero.sub: Stainless steel skimmer with spiral wire

feat.title: Open Wire Drains Fast
feat.sub: Round skimmer with spiral wire and long metal handle
feats: Drains oil fast and holds fried food
Keeps your hand away from hot oil
At the handle end to hang on a hook
Deep frying, boiling vegetables and pasta

steps.title: How to Use It
steps: The open wire drains oil fast
Holds pieces, keeps hand from hot oil
Rinse, then hang it on the hook

uses.title: For Frying and Boiling
uses.sub: Lifts fried and boiled food from the pot
uses.note: Also suits samosas, falafel and noodles
